premises.text: Mental health conditions are a significant social and economic issue.
premises.evidence_span: mental health conditions are a massive social and economic issue.

premises.text: Many individuals with mental health conditions do not receive care.
premises.evidence_span: two in three of those diagnosed get zero care whatsoever.

premises.text: Certain populations, like veterans, face higher suicide rates.
premises.evidence_span: 20 veterans take their own lives daily.

premises.text: Current mental health resources do not effectively reach those in need.
premises.evidence_span: the majority of veterans who are dead by suicide last year weren't in any form of VA care.

premises.text: A mobile app can broaden access to psychotherapy.
premises.evidence_span: a mobile app for text-based group psychotherapy powered by natural language processing.

premises.text: Natural language processing can enhance the efficiency of mental health providers.
premises.evidence_span: advanced NLP algorithms to run on user messages and detect messages containing suicidality or maliciousness.

premises.text: B2B SaaS model can effectively license technology to existing healthcare providers.
premises.evidence_span: we deploy with the B2B SaaS Enterprise Model, where we license out this technology to organizations.

premises.text: Combining peer support with clinical therapy can improve mental health outcomes.
premises.evidence_span: marry the persistence of peer support with the demonstrated clinical efficacy of therapy.

premises.text: Existing solutions for mental health care are not scalable and accessible.
premises.evidence_span: their one patient to one provider model isn't scalable, and this prices the majority of people out of reach of these solutions.

value.text: Mental health care becomes more accessible and effective through technology.
value.evidence_span: bring your mental healthcare infrastructure into the 21st century.

notes: Traction metrics and funding details excluded as they do not support premises.
